How-to guide

Troubleshoot common problems

Goal

Match a message or symptom you see while installing or using the app to its cause and fix. Every message below is quoted from the app or its setup scripts.

Installing and starting

Setup stops with a line starting Missing:

A required tool is not installed or is too old. The line names the tool and where to get it, for example Missing: node 18 or later — install from https://nodejs.org. Install it and run ./setup.sh again. The script stops before it creates anything when a tool is missing.

Setup prints Install python3-venv (for example: sudo apt install python3-venv), then run ./setup.sh again

Your Python cannot create a virtual environment (this happens on Debian and Ubuntu systems). Install the package the message names, then run ./setup.sh again.

Setup prints Error: npm ci failed (output above). ...

The JavaScript packages did not install. Read the npm output printed above that line, check your network connection, and run ./setup.sh again.

run.py prints Port 5000 is in use. Start with PORT=<other> python3 run.py

Another program is using port 5000. Start the app on a different port and open that address:

PORT=5001 python3 run.py

The browser shows "Development Mode — The frontend hasn't been built yet"

The web interface was not built. Run ./setup.sh again (it builds the interface), or run npm run build in the project folder, then restart python3 run.py.

While using the app

The top bar says offline

The app cannot reach its backend. Look at the terminal where python3 run.py is running: if it has stopped or shows an error, start it again and reload the page. While the status is offline, Verify words and Clean grid are disabled.

The top bar says degraded

The backend is running but reports that part of itself is unhealthy. Restart python3 run.py; if it persists, check the terminal for errors.

Autofill finished but the grid did not change

For some endings the grid shows its pre-run state until you click a Keep button. See the outcome table in Autofill a grid. After any result, Start Autofill stays hidden until you click Reset. If the run ended with a message about highlighted letters, the red squares are letters already in the grid that no word fits; change them and run again.

Autofill's result has entries that are not words

Autofill is known to be imperfect. Use Verify words and Clean grid (Check and clean a grid), or run autofill again; results differ from run to run. Open issues are listed under "Known Limitations" in the README.

A save fails: Could not save: browser storage is full. Delete a saved grid or export this one.

The browser's storage for this site is full. Delete saved grids you no longer need (Open saved, then Delete) or export the grid (Import and export grids).

A word list upload is refused

The upload preview reports how many lines were skipped and why. If no line is valid the upload is refused. See Use your own word lists for what a valid line is. The shipped lists cannot be overwritten or deleted; the app tells you to create a custom list instead.

A theme word file is rejected

The toast starts Invalid theme words: and the panel lists each problem: a word that is too short (under 3 letters) or longer than the grid, or a list of more than 50 words. Any one problem rejects the whole list, so fix the file and load it again. A file over 1 MB is refused with File too large (max 1MB). See Add theme words.

A theme word is missing from Loaded Words

A line that contains a space, hyphen or digit is dropped without a message. Write ICECREAM, not ICE CREAM.

An import is rejected

The message says which part of the file is wrong, for example Invalid file type. Please select a .json file. or Grid row 2 has 14 cells, expected 15. See Import and export grids for the format.

Final Result

The message you saw no longer appears, or you know which step to change.
